camera_key_note: Left eye of the side-by-side ZED Mini stereo pair, mounted on the H1 head = the egocentric stream. Confirmed against cet/post_process_zed.py in RogerQi/human-policy, which splits the SBS stereo mp4 into left_imgs/right_imgs and writes them to 'observation.image.left'/'observation.image.right'. The 'observation.image.right' dataset is the right eye of the SAME head camera, not a second viewpoint.

hdf5_root_attrs.description: grasp a black chocolate bottle on the yellow plate with the right hand, grasp a gray plastic cup with the left hand, pour the black chocolate into the cup, place the cup back, place the bottle on the purple plate

encoding.image_storage: per-frame JPEG byte arrays, zero-padded to a fixed row width; decode with cv2.imdecode(row, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR) (trailing zero padding after the JPEG EOI is tolerated)
encoding.fps_source: ZED_FREQ = 30 in cet/post_process_zed.py (RogerQi/human-policy); ph2d_metadata.json maps embodiment h1_inspire -> camera UCSD_H1_ZED
encoding.ffmpeg: rawvideo bgr24 640x480 @30 -> libx264 crf 18 preset medium, yuv420p, +faststart

substitution_note: Two deviations from the brief, both verified against the data rather than assumed. (1) RESOLUTION: the brief said the ZED Mini stream is 1280x720, but the JPEGs stored inside the processed HDF5 decode to 640x480. 1280x720 is the RAW sensor resolution recorded in ph2d_metadata.json (cameras.UCSD_H1_ZED.resolution) and used as original_res in the post-processing script; the released HDF5s hold a cropped/downscaled 640x480 version. 640x480 is the highest resolution actually available in this file - no 720p source exists in the repo. (2) TASK LABEL: the manifest describes row 20 as 'Pour water in front of a drink vending machine'. The actual episode is a tabletop pour - per the HDF5's own description attribute, the H1 grasps a chocolate-drink bottle and a gray plastic cup and pours between them on a table. No vending machine is visible in the frames. The folder specified by the manifest selector was used verbatim, so the video is the intended source; only the manifest's task text is inaccurate.
selector_resolution: Manifest selector was folder='501-pouring-2024_11_12-23_39_22', pick='first HDF5'. The folder sits at the TOP LEVEL of the repo (no nesting) and holds 48 files, processed_episode_{11..61}.hdf5 with gaps (14, 31, 56 absent). processed_episode_11.hdf5 is first under BOTH lexicographic and numeric ordering, so 'first HDF5' is unambiguous.
provenance: Folder 501-* is listed under 'train' in hdt/configs/datasets/pouring/pouring_teleop.json in RogerQi/human-policy, confirming it is robot teleop (H1) data and not a human demonstration - consistent with the manifest's '(robot, H1)'. ph2d_metadata.json per_task_attributes gives task_type=pouring, embodiment_type=h1_inspire, left_hand=true, right_hand=true.
